capabilities: capture webpages as Markdown notes from the command palette, bookmarklets, or mobile share sheet
extract page metadata like tags, byline, site name, and dates into frontmatter
customize property keys, order, formatting, and custom properties
slurp only the frontmatter for note-taking captures
extras: Detailed usage documentation lives outside the README. Browser extensions for Firefox and Chrome-compatible browsers are in beta and must be manually installed; BRAT can be used for beta testing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save a webpage as a clean Markdown note, so users must copy, paste, and strip clutter by hand.

relations.evidence: Mozilla's Readability powers the underlying conversion.

summary: Web clipper that saves webpages as clean, uncluttered Markdown notes with automatically generated frontmatter metadata.
